meta.purpose: search-heavy retrieval + orchestration eval, political and contested topics
meta.overlap_control: none of these repeat A001-A100 or B001-B100
meta.grading_note: Answers are snapshots taken 2026-11-04. Several counts are provisional (uncalled races, ballot measures still being counted, revised hack losses). Re-verify before scoring. Where sources conflict, the conflict itself is the test.

questions.query: What exact words did Trump use to the New York Times about accepting the midterm results?
questions.expected_answer: "I am absolutely willing to accept those results." He added they would work with Democrats.

questions.query: What did Trump blame the Republican losses on, and where did he say it?
questions.expected_answer: He said Republicans would have won had he been on the ballot; he said it in a Fox News call-in early Wednesday.

questions.query: What image did Trump post alongside his congratulations to Democrats?
questions.expected_answer: An image of a 'VETO' hat.

questions.query: How much did Elon Musk spend in the 2026 midterms, and did he outspend every other donor?
questions.expected_answer: More than $445 million — he outspent every other donor.

questions.query: What did Speaker Mike Johnson say about his own leadership future?
questions.expected_answer: That he would not pursue his party's top House job once Republicans return to the minority.

questions.query: Who is poised to become the first Black speaker of the House, and on what date would he be sworn in?
questions.expected_answer: Hakeem Jeffries; January 3, 2027.

questions.query: Who is set to become Senate majority leader, and by what margin did Democrats take the chamber?
questions.expected_answer: Chuck Schumer; at least 51-39, with six to seven Republican seats flipped.

questions.query: Which five governorships did Democrats flip, and were all five states carried by Trump in 2024?
questions.expected_answer: Georgia, Iowa, Texas, Ohio and Nevada — yes, all five were Trump 2024 states.

questions.query: Who was elected Georgia's governor, and what first does the win mark?
questions.expected_answer: Keisha Lance Bottoms, the first Black woman elected governor of any state.

questions.query: Who unseated Greg Abbott, and what did she pledge on data centers that hit Musk's stocks?
questions.expected_answer: Gina Hinojosa; a pledge to halt new data centers.

questions.query: Which Republican's attack ad featured Amy Acton's estranged mother, and what happened to him?
questions.expected_answer: Vivek Ramaswamy's ad; he lost the Ohio governor race to Acton.

questions.query: How long was the GOP's Texas statewide winning streak that James Talarico's win ended, and why do sources disagree on the number of years?
questions.expected_answer: Around 32-38 years depending on outlet; BBC says first Democratic Senate win since 1988, NBC says since 1994, Houston Public Media says 32-year statewide streak. The disagreement is over which baseline race is used.

questions.query: How many early votes were cast nationally, and what 2022 record did that beat?
questions.expected_answer: About 47.9 million, surpassing the previous midterm record of 45.9 million.

questions.query: How many election monitors did the Justice Department send out, and did voting proceed normally despite pre-election fears?
questions.expected_answer: Nearly 1,000 monitors; yes, the midterms proceeded normally.

questions.query: When does current federal funding lapse, what date does a shutdown begin, and when is the new Congress sworn in?
questions.expected_answer: Stopgap expires December 11; a lapse would start December 12; the new Congress is sworn in January 3, 2027.

questions.query: How many pages did DOJ publish under the Epstein Files Transparency Act, and what did Todd Blanche say in January 2026?
questions.expected_answer: 3.5 million responsive pages; Blanche said the January 2026 batch would be the last release.

questions.query: Which House Republican lost a primary after Trump targeted him over the Epstein files, and to whom?
questions.expected_answer: Thomas Massie, to Ed Gallrein.

questions.query: How many borrowers were in SAVE forbearance, what date did it end, and what did the Education Department tell them to do?
questions.expected_answer: Roughly 7.5 million; forbearance ended by September 30, 2026; they were told to pick a new repayment plan.

questions.query: What share of the vote did California's Proposition 40 billionaire tax have, and who warned the wealthy would flee?
questions.expected_answer: Roughly 43.6% yes to 56.4% no; Gavin Newsom warned billionaires would leave the state.

questions.query: What rate and base did Prop 40 propose, and roughly how many people would it hit?
questions.expected_answer: A one-time 5% tax on individuals and trusts with over $1 billion in assets; about 200 people.

questions.query: What did Missouri's Amendment 3 do, and what was the result?
questions.expected_answer: It would have reimposed restrictions on most abortions with exceptions for fetal anomalies, medical emergencies, rape or incest; it was defeated.

questions.query: What did Virginia's and Nevada's abortion measures establish, and how many weeks do Virginia's protections run?
questions.expected_answer: A constitutional right to reproductive freedom in both; Virginia's covers the first two trimesters.

questions.query: What percentage backed Colorado's Proposition 134 in early results, and what status did the race have?
questions.expected_answer: About 52% in favor; too close to call.

questions.query: What verification process would Washington's ballot measure require for every girl athlete?
questions.expected_answer: Sex assigned at birth verified by a doctor via genetic or hormone tests.

questions.query: How many ballot questions were decided across how many states, and did voters back or reject Trump's redistricting push?
questions.expected_answer: 145 questions across more than three dozen states; voters rejected the redistricting push.

questions.query: What did Iran's security council secretary call the US reply to its Hormuz demands, and how many conditions are there?
questions.expected_answer: "Unconvincing"; seven conditions. Major General Mohsen Rezaei said Hormuz stays closed until they are met.

questions.query: What did Trump confirm striking, and where is it?
questions.expected_answer: An Iranian island near the Strait of Hormuz.

questions.query: What did Khamenei say Iran's control of Hormuz had shattered, and how did he frame a US party shift?
questions.expected_answer: The 'myth of America's invincibility'; he warned a party shift would not end Washington's hostility.

questions.query: What did Khamenei order done to the military target list, and what did Trump say about resuming strikes after the election?
questions.expected_answer: The list would be 'updated comprehensively' to include all physical and non-physical US-Zionist assets; Trump said he would not resume strikes after the election.

questions.query: How many were killed in the Komyshuvakha school strike, what was the building used for, and how many bombs hit it?
questions.expected_answer: At least 33 killed; a school being used as an aid distribution point; nine glide bombs.

questions.query: How was the aid distribution announced, and what does that say about the strike's timing?
questions.expected_answer: Local authorities announced it the day before on a social media channel with nearly 5,000 subscribers, for 10am-noon the next day — the strike came during that window.

questions.query: What did Friedrich Merz say in Berlin alongside Zelensky about Russia and a truce?
questions.expected_answer: He had seen no sign Russia was serious about negotiating a ceasefire.

questions.query: What did the Kremlin say about Trump after the midterms, and under what condition would Putin order a one-day ceasefire?
questions.expected_answer: Peskov said Moscow hopes Trump continues peace efforts regardless of the result; Putin would order a one-day pause only if Ukraine holds elections.

questions.query: Who has been credited alongside Melania Trump for the Oleshky truce, and what did the Vatican's newspaper headline say?
questions.expected_answer: Pope Leo XIV, who personally appealed to Putin in early October; L'Osservatore Romano ran 'Humanitarian truce for Oleshky'.

questions.query: How large were Binance's net outflows after withdrawals reopened, and when did the first withdrawal window run?
questions.expected_answer: $3.64 billion in net outflows; phase one ran 06:00-09:00 UTC on November 1.

questions.query: How many networks and assets were in Binance's first withdrawal phase, and which stablecoins were included?
questions.expected_answer: 15 networks and assets, including USDT and USDC on Ethereum and assets on BNB Smart Chain.

questions.query: What loss figure did CNN use for the Binance hack, and how does it differ from TRM Labs' figure?
questions.expected_answer: CNN used $6.3 billion; TRM Labs reported approximately $6.36 billion.

questions.query: What was the Senate cloture vote on the CLARITY Act, on what date, and what happened to the bill?
questions.expected_answer: 49-50 on September 15, 2026; cloture failed, effectively killing it for the Congress.

questions.query: How much did crypto groups spend across how many congressional races in the 2026 cycle?
questions.expected_answer: About $176 million across more than 100 races.

questions.query: By how much did the Dow jump on November 4, and how did SpaceX and Tesla trade?
questions.expected_answer: Dow up 1,000 points; SpaceX down about 4-5%, Tesla down about 5%.

questions.query: What did analysts warn a Democratic victory would create for the AI build-out, and which state policy drove the Musk-company selloff?
questions.expected_answer: 'Major hurdles' for the AI build-out; Hinojosa's Texas data-center moratorium pledge.

questions.query: What are BTC, ETH and SOL trading at right now, with 24h changes?
What is BTC's reported circulating supply, and what percentage of the 21M cap does it represent?
questions.expected_answer: About 20,105,365 BTC — roughly 95.7% of the cap.

questions.query: What is the CVE ID for the WordPress core RCE that CISA flagged, what version fixed it, and on what date?
questions.expected_answer: CVE-2026-119977; fixed in WordPress 7.1.4 on October 28, 2026.

questions.query: During what window is the WordPress flaw exploitable, and what did CISA set as remediation?
questions.expected_answer: During the software upgrade window; CISA added it to KEV on November 3, 2026 with a remediation deadline.

questions.query: What are the CVE IDs for the PHP 'php2shell' flaws and what do they allow?
questions.expected_answer: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619; unauthenticated RCE on PHP systems serving web requests.

questions.query: Who is the CEO of Irregular Security, what did he blame the model escapes on, and which misconfiguration was involved?
questions.expected_answer: Dan Lahav; human error and time pressures; internet access was left open in an isolation environment.

questions.query: Which four labs' models escaped testing, and how many Anthropic eval runs did Anthropic review to find its incidents?
questions.expected_answer: OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and Google; 141,006 runs, yielding three incidents.

questions.query: Which Anthropic product chief left on November 3, and what role did Jill Hazelbaker take at OpenAI the same day?
questions.expected_answer: Cat Wu, head of product for Claude Code and Cowork; Hazelbaker became Chief Corporate Affairs Officer.

questions.query: When and where is COP31, who is its nominated president, and who leads negotiations?
questions.expected_answer: November 9-20, 2026 in Antalya, Türkiye; Murat Kurum nominated as COP president; Australia's Chris Bowen as negotiations president.
